title: A 16-game international week was never a possibility during 2020 CBA talks

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: A 16-game international week was never a possibility during 2020 CBA talks
sources.description: On Sunday, Steelers quarterback Aaron Rodgers claimed that, during the 2020 Collective Bargaining Agreement negotiations, a discussion was had regarding the possibility of a full-blown "international week."
